affected_objects.content: A repair mechanism has been added to the data processing pipeline. It merges 'fallback' units, which are created from lines missed during initial processing, into adjacent, correctly identified idea units.

Within a single meeting, new `idea units` on the same topic are merged into an existing L1 memory node. This merging process is strictly confined to the scope of a single meeting and does not occur across different meetings.
為了維持會議之間的上下文隔離，將相似的「idea unit」合併到記憶節點的過程嚴格限制在單次會議內，不進行跨會議合併。
